# Generated files

Built from [main](https://github.com/jaladh-singhal/irsa-knowledge-map/tree/8b8c1cf4dc6ff503e2dfd418041ec691e3e64726) by
`.github/workflows/publish-generated.yml`; don't edit them here.

Each mission's `<mission>.md` is its [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org): a short summary for
AI assistants, readable here too, of the mission's releases and how to query each dataset.
